action.name: Multiattack
entries: The myrmidon makes three Flail attacks.

action.name: Flail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) force damage.

action.name: Lightning Strike {@recharge}
entries: The myrmidon makes one Flail attack. On a hit, the target takes an extra 18 ({@damage 4d8}) lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.
